Reject a proposal

Usage:
  kaab proposals reject PROPOSAL_ID [flags]

Flags:
  -h, --help            help for reject
      --reason string   why

Global Flags:
      --base-url string   API base URL (KAAB_BASE_URL; https://api.kaab.ist/v1 by default)
      --json              print the API's JSON instead of a table
      --profile string    profile to use (KAAB_PROFILE; the current profile by default)
      --test              use the profile's test-mode key (sk_test_)
